title: Example 171: a retry route that skips the dead letter for a client error, refuted by the effect trace
description: build.py runs example 171 end to end (foundations O3, the rest, step 2): the refactor of example 170 with a shortcut that answers 200 for a 4xx other than 408 and 429 without dead-lettering. The answer is unchanged and the tests pass; jvmcontract effects must refute the send trace with a witness replayed on a JVM under the recording stubs. Inline on 2026-11-07: refuted at status=400, idempotent=false, attempts=0 (old: one dead letter; new: no modeled call).
expected: verdict violation, matchesExpected true; one counterexample with the old build's dead-letter send and the new build's no modeled call; replay by jvm

resources.notes: build.py compiles two copies of the deliveries app with Crosscut's kernels (a few seconds each) and runs jvmcontract effects twice, under a second each; the release build of jvmcontract, if the runner has none, is most of the time
